steps.prompt: IMPORTANT LAYOUT: the output must be exactly 8 columns x 8 rows = 64 sprites, SQUARE canvas, laid out like the FIRST attached image. Do NOT copy the 4x6 layout of the second image, it is only for the look. Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The SECOND attached image is Mộc Lộc at its LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage: THIS is the character to draw, exactly as it looks there: its head size, neck, shell or body shape, body proportions, face, colours, markings and accessories. The FIRST attached image is the same creature at its smaller CHILD stage and is ONLY a pose and layout guide: four 4x4 blocks, top-left block = facing down (towards the viewer), top-right = facing down-right, bottom-left = facing right, bottom-right = facing up-right; in each block row 1 guard stance x4, row 2 run x4, row 3 attack wind-up / slash / recover / dash, row 4 charge / release / hit / stunned. Draw the LEGENDARY character in every cell, doing the pose of the matching cell of the guide, with the same facing and the same order; do NOT copy the child's proportions, big head or face. The same grid of 8 columns x 8 rows, pixel art with a dark outline, every sprite fully inside its own cell, centred, all at the same size, feet on the same line within a row, sprites not touching. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). Small cells are fine: a clean readable silhouette true to the LEGENDARY matters more than fine detail. Square canvas 1:1.

IMPORTANT LAYOUT: the output must be exactly 8 columns x 4 rows = 32 sprites, WIDE 2:1 canvas, laid out like the FIRST attached image. Do NOT copy the 4x6 layout of the second image, it is only for the look. Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The SECOND attached image is Mộc Lộc at its LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage: THIS is the character to draw, exactly as it looks there: its head size, neck, shell or body shape, body proportions, face, colours, markings and accessories. The FIRST attached image is the same creature at its smaller CHILD stage and is ONLY a pose and layout guide: the left 4x4 block is facing up (back to the viewer) (row 1 guard x4, row 2 run x4, row 3 attack wind-up / slash / recover / dash, row 4 charge / release / hit / stunned); the top-right 4x2 block is the front view: knocked down x2, victory x2, then ultimate charge x2, ultimate release x2; the bottom-right 4x2 is empty. Draw the LEGENDARY character in every cell, doing the pose of the matching cell of the guide, with the same facing and the same order; do NOT copy the child's proportions, big head or face. The same grid of 8 columns x 4 rows, pixel art with a dark outline, every sprite fully inside its own cell, centred, all at the same size, feet on the same line within a row, sprites not touching. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). Small cells are fine: a clean readable silhouette true to the LEGENDARY matters more than fine detail. Wide canvas 2:1. Leave the bottom-right 4x2 block empty magenta.
